name: broken-promises-sacrifice-draw-quest
notes: Broken Promises (re911j7fo4, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["re911j7fo4:0"]; additional-cost sacrifice wired in Custom/GameLogic.php ~2813 (BrokenPromisesCost)): "As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice a Fatestone item or Fatebound ally. Draw a card into your memory. [Guo Jia Bonus] Put a quest counter on your champion." The champion is patched to Guo Jia, Chosen Disciple with Spirit of Fire kept in Subcards (a real level-up would preserve it there too) so CanPlayerUseCardElement() grants FIRE access for this FIRE card, and IsGuoJiaBonus() reads true. A Craggy Fatestone (ITEM, FATESTONE subtype) is seeded onto the field to satisfy the mandatory sacrifice. Verified live: after playing Broken Promises, sacrificing the Craggy Fatestone (myField-1, moved to graveyard), and paying the 1-reserve cost, the champion's Counters go from {} to {"quest":1} and a card moves from deck into memory. Break/restore verified: commenting out DrawIntoMemory()/AddQuestCounters() makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice a Fatestone item or a Fatebound ally.
Draw a card into your memory.
[Guo Jia Bonus] Put a quest counter on your champion.
